newsitems.contents: Small hotfix to address some concerns that have cropped up. Bug Fixes Fixed certain projectiles getting stuck on physics and staying around longer than intended. Fixed an issue with server side handling of slash commands.

newsitems.contents: Hello Everybody! It's getting chilly out there, and that means that it's almost time for another Winter's Feast! This year we're having Winter's Feast with Pearl; with new craftables, new skins, login bonus, streaming drops as well as our regular Winter's Feast drop rate increase. For more details, you can check out the beta here. So, come in from the cold and join us for Winter's Feast on December 18th at 10am pacific.
